To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of software fault tolerance in real-time systems can result in a substantial improvement in reliability.

the use of software fault tolerance can increase reliability by a factor of about 10, that the cost of software fault tolerance is not prohibitive, and that there are a variety of ways in which the reliability of software can be improved.

(i) the use of the software redundancy approach to fault tolerance can yield substantial reliability improvement; (ii) the reliability improvement is dependent on the degree of redundancy, the degree of independence of the redundant modules, and the degree of fault tolerance provided; (iii) a high degree of fault tolerance is required for a significant improvement in reliability; (iv) the reliability improvement can be achieved without significant degradation of performance
In summary, our research is concerned with
the application of software fault tolerance to the design and implementation of a real-world command and control system for naval warfare.
the development and application of software fault tolerance (SFT) techniques to enhance the reliability of practical software systems, and in particular, real-time systems.
the development and experimental evaluation of software techniques to improve the reliability of practical computer based systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
software fault tolerance is a viable approach to the problem of achieving reliable software in practical systems.
software fault tolerance is a viable and practical approach to the design of reliable systems.
the techniques developed and applied in this research project were shown to be capable of achieving significant improvements in the reliability of practical real-time systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
software fault tolerance techniques are a viable and practical approach to enhancing the reliability of real-time systems.
, for the particular system and environment considered, the reliability of the system could be improved by a factor of 2-4.
software fault tolerance is a feasible approach to improving the reliability of complex systems and that it can be applied in a practical way.
